title: Super Dolly In
description: A super dolly in is a long aggressive travel that eats the room, parallax violent, the face arriving too fast. It is a dolly in stretched until geography collapses into a close-up in one move.

sections.title: Narrative function

blocks.text: A normal dolly is not enough. The room is consumed: lamps, furniture, and walls shear hard, and the face is suddenly too close.
Threat, obsession, a corridor that becomes a portrait. A crash zoom does this optically with no shear.
A polite dolly-in keeps manners. Super is length plus speed plus violent parallax.
If the path is short, you only had a push.

sections.title: How it works

blocks.text: Long track or a long steadicam drive on the lens axis, often wide at the start so the room can be eaten. Speed is high; the end is a close-up.
Prompt: Super dolly in on [Subject], a long aggressive travel that eats the room, parallax violent, the face arriving too fast.

sections.title: When to use it

blocks.text: Use it when approach must feel too much: a threat, a corridor, a face that arrives early. Do not use it for a gentle thought.

sections.title: In film

blocks.text: The Shining's long hotel approaches eat space toward a person, whether on wheels or a vest. Oldboy's corridor drive-in is the grammar of a long aggressive travel that becomes a fight and a face.
Use them as space-eating approach, not as frames to copy.

sections.title: What usually goes wrong

blocks.text: The usual wrong cousin is a crash zoom or a short push. The tell: no long shear of the room, or the whole picture simply enlarges.
The fix: a long physical path, violent parallax, face arriving too fast.

sections.title: Questions

blocks.text: What is Super Dolly In in film?
A super dolly in is a long, fast physical approach that eats the room with violent parallax until the face is suddenly close.
Super Dolly In vs Dolly In
A dolly in is a controlled approach. Super dolly in is the same axis stretched in length and speed until geography collapses into a close-up.
When should I use Super Dolly In?
Use it when a polite approach is not enough: threat, corridor, obsession. Do not use it for a gentle thought.
How do I prompt Super Dolly In for AI image or video?
Write a long fast travel with violent parallax. Example: Super dolly in on [Subject], a long aggressive travel that eats the room, the face arriving too fast.
